denylist_note: Decision D3 (spec §11): the exclusion covers the OPERATOR / CVC only — MUCAP, MUIP, and any MUFG-branded program — because Dais works there and the conflict is real. A fund that merely has MUFG as an LP is NOT excluded: an LP has no visibility into applicant material, so the conflict does not exist. Do not widen these substrings into an LP screen.
notes: Precision, not volume: 3-5 sends per day, subject < 60 chars, body < 1000 chars, at most 2 follow-ups spaced 3-7 days. The corporate-partner roster of each program is re-checked before every submission; the denylist alone is not the whole gate.
